name: Dreary Village
desc1: This appears to be a small town nestled in the centre of the valley.
desc2: It presents a disheartening sight, even vaguely disturbing, as it is
desc3: constructed largely of grey stone and charcoal-coloured wood. Torches
desc4: set in the sides of the buildings provide the only light. A smallish
desc5: stone building stands to the north, the sign on its door showing an
desc6: open sack. To the south, a low wooden structure stands, its door
desc7: nailed shut and crossed over with planks. Its sign shows a mug of ale.
